lines.instruct: 自然生活化对白，语气克制，停连随语义变化，不要播音腔，不要机械匀速; energy: controlled, pace: medium
lines.text: That cloud could contain about five hundred fifty tons of water.

lines.instruct: 自然生活化对白，语气克制，停连随语义变化，不要播音腔，不要机械匀速; energy: controlled, pace: medium
lines.text: For a one-kilometre-cube cumulus estimate, the number is about five hundred fifty-one tons.

lines.instruct: 自然生活化对白，语气克制，停连随语义变化，不要播音腔，不要机械匀速; energy: controlled, pace: medium
lines.text: That is liquid water—tiny droplets spread through a huge volume.

lines.instruct: 自然生活化对白，语气克制，停连随语义变化，不要播音腔，不要机械匀速; energy: controlled, pace: medium
lines.text: So why does it not simply fall? Because cloudy air can be less dense than the drier air around it.

lines.instruct: 自然生活化对白，语气克制，停连随语义变化，不要播音腔，不要机械匀速; energy: controlled, pace: medium
lines.text: And inside the cloud, rising air keeps carrying droplets upward.

lines.instruct: 轻声安慰，语速稍慢，呼吸自然，句尾放松，不要刻意煽情; energy: controlled, pace: medium
lines.text: It is not weightless. It is heavy water riding inside a moving layer of air.

lines.instruct: 轻声安慰，语速稍慢，呼吸自然，句尾放松，不要刻意煽情; energy: controlled, pace: medium
lines.text: When droplets grow faster than the updraft can carry them, they break through as rain.

lines.instruct: 自然生活化对白，语气克制，停连随语义变化，不要播音腔，不要机械匀速; energy: controlled, pace: medium
lines.text: A cloud can be heavy and still float.
